policy.smap: AM only; retrieval bits 0/1 unset, surface_flag=0, error <= max_smap_error
policy.surface_screen: Conservative; may reject otherwise usable flagged terrain. Requires regional policy review.
policy.pqi_screen: Finite nonnegative values only; no product-specific acceptance threshold specified in PDF
policy.anomaly: Same ISO week in earlier calendar years, available by cutoff
policy.lags: Exact calendar offsets from t-2, no interpolation
policy.soil_units: sand/silt/clay g/kg; soc g/kg; bdod kg/dm3; water m3/m3; uncertainty retained in source scaled units
policy.latency: Measurement dates align, but publication times are not certified by these files
